story_text:
## 🤖 | Meet AI WUKONG
## ✨ | What Makes WUKONG So Fun?
## 🎬 | See AI WUKONG in Action
## 🕺 | Little Robot. Big Moves.
Driven by 14 high-precision servo actuators across its head, arms, waist, and legs, Wukong 2 performs complex bipedal locomotion, dynamic balance adjustments, and flexible acrobatic motions.
## 😊 | A Little Character, Head to Toe
## 💬 | Talk with WUKONG
## 👀 | See the World with WUKONG
Combining vision recognition and audio output, Wukong 2 scans physical educational storybooks page-by-page, functioning as an interactive reading helper and dual-language learning tool.
## 🏠 | Stay Connected from Anywhere
Built-in HD camera and remote mobility controls enable seamless video calls. Users can remotely check in on home activities, navigate the robot around the room, and stay connected with family members anytime.
## 💻 | Learn to Code with WUKONG
## 🎵 | Create Your Own Moves
Offers a comprehensive STEM programming path supporting both graphical drag-and-drop Blockly coding and advanced MicroPython scripting, helping users master robotic movement logic and text-based coding.
An intuitive visual timeline tool allows users to manually sequence servo movements. Easily program, edit, and fine-tune unique robotic choreography, martial arts moves, or customized dance routines.
## ☁️ | Meet the Cloud Stand
Cloud Stand is available as an optional add-on or included in the All-in-One Pack.
Includes a smart charging station that enables automated self-docking. Keeps the robot powered for continuous classroom demonstrations, testing sessions, and desktop development without manual cable plugging.

## About Us
UBTECH Robotics is a global pioneer in humanoid robotics and embodied AI, dedicated to bringing intelligent robots into every home. Since 2012, we have built a full stack of proprietary technologies—from advanced LLM decision-making to high-precision hardware and motion control. Holding the world’s largest portfolio of humanoid robot patents, UBTECH delivers cutting-edge robotic solutions across industrial, commercial, and consumer applications worldwide.
Building on our core embodied AI technology, the AI WUKONG series represents our flagship line of desktop humanoid companion robots. Designed to bridge advanced AI with everyday life, AI WUKONG brings together interactive learning, multi-modal sensing, and warm, expressive companionship for homes and tech enthusiasts around the globe.
risks: Bringing a complex, intelligent bipedal robot like AI WUKONG to mass production involves inherent hardware and software engineering challenges. As a publicly traded leader in robotics (UBTECH Robotics, HKEX: 9880.HK), we are committed to full transparency, rigorous quality control, and open communication with our backer community throughout the entire fulfillment process. 1. Hardware & Mass Production Quality Control AI WUKONG integrates 14 high-precision servo actuators, multi-modal sensors, and complex bipedal mechanics. Component inconsistencies or assembly variance could impact motion smooth operations. Mitigation: We have completed pre-production verification, EVT/DVT testing, and functional prototype testing. Leveraging our state-of-the-art smart manufacturing facilities and established global supply chain partners, we enforce strict ISO-standard quality controls to ensure high yields and component reliability before mass shipping. 2. Software Optimization & AI Model Integration Delivering a seamless multi-turn LLM conversational experience alongside long-term memory processing requires continuous cloud infrastructure tuning, latency optimization, and localized language alignment. Mitigation: Our proprietary software platforms (including ROSA 2.0) are already heavily tested and deployed in real-world environments. Our engineering team will continuously push over-the-air (OTA) firmware updates throughout production and post-delivery to ensure optimal AI responsiveness, privacy protection, and software stability. 3. Supply Chain & Logistics Timelines Global shipping, custom clearances, and component sourcing delays are common risks in hardware crowdfunding campaigns. Mitigation: We have secured core long-lead components in advance and partnered with tier-1 international logistics fulfillment services to oversee global distribution. We aim to begin delivery according to our timeline in February 2027. Should any unexpected supply chain or customs delay occur, we guarantee transparent bi-weekly updates directly on Kickstarter.

faq.q: What are the primary differences between AI WUKONG (Gen 2) and the Gen 1 model?
faq.a: AI WUKONG (Gen 2) is a comprehensive upgrade powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) with long-term memory capabilities. It features an upgraded 5MP wide-angle camera with PIR motion sensing, a dedicated 24/7 charging dock, two-way video calling, multi-robot swarm control, and a expanded STEM coding engine supporting both Blockly and MicroPython.

faq.q: What programming languages does AI WUKONG support for STEM learning?
faq.a: AI WUKONG supports a multi-tier learning curve: beginners can use our intuitive visual drag-and-drop Blockly interface, while advanced users and developers can write text-based MicroPython/uPython scripts or access our Open SDK & RESTful APIs.

faq.q: What can AI WUKONG do besides chatting?
faq.a: AI WUKONG combines conversation with physical movement and expressive interaction. It can walk, dance, perform kung fu poses, and express itself through facial animations and body movements. It also offers visual recognition, interactive storybook reading, and tools for creating your own robot routines.

faq.q: Do I need coding experience to enjoy AI WUKONG?
faq.a: No coding experience is needed to enjoy AI WUKONG’s built-in interactions and movement routines. If you want to explore further, visual programming tools provide an approachable way to start creating your own behaviors before moving on to more advanced coding.

faq.q: Can I create my own movements and dance routines?
faq.a: Yes! AI WUKONG’s visual timeline tool lets you sequence and adjust movements to create custom routines. You can combine head, arm, waist, and leg movements into your own choreography, from a simple greeting to a personalized dance.

faq.q: What does 14 degrees of freedom mean?
faq.a: AI WUKONG has 14 independently controlled movement axes across its head, arms, waist, and legs. Working together, they allow it to perform coordinated movements such as walking, dancing, turning, and striking expressive poses.

faq.q: How does AI WUKONG support storybook reading?
faq.a: AI WUKONG combines visual recognition with spoken responses to support interactive reading with compatible physical storybooks. It recognizes supported page content and provides audio interaction, adding another way to explore stories and language learning.

faq.q: Can I see through AI WUKONG’s camera and control it remotely?
faq.a: Yes. AI WUKONG combines a built-in camera with remote viewing and movement controls, allowing you to see from the robot’s perspective and guide its movements. These connected features require a network connection.

faq.q: How is AI WUKONG different from an AI chatbot on my phone?
faq.a: AI WUKONG brings interaction into the physical world. Alongside spoken responses, it uses facial expressions and coordinated body movements to make interactions more expressive. You can also explore robot motion and create custom routines—experiences that go beyond a conversation on a screen.
